items.title: Integrate pinned Gitleaks history and worktree scanning
items.complexityRationale: Introduces an external binary, checksum/provenance maintenance, cross-platform installation, CI, redaction, and fixture allowlists.
items.scope: isolated audit tools, Gitleaks configuration, audit runner, security workflow, and fixtures
implementationSteps: Approve and pin an official Gitleaks version and SHA-256 per platform.
Run redacted worktree and --all reachable-history scans.
Scan tracked reports and reject unreviewed or expired allowlists.
Add full-history CI with immutable action or binary pins.
acceptanceCriteria: Current and historical seeded secrets fail.
Reports and all local refs are scanned.
Scanner provenance and configuration digest are recorded.
verification: Run scanner fixture suite on every supported OS.
Run the audit evidence collector and confirm history status completed.
items.rollout: Local isolated integration first, then CI enforcement after cross-platform evidence.
items.rollback: Remove scanner integration and restore blocked history status; never downgrade to complete.
items.approvalReason: Requires approved external download, provenance verification, and CI network execution.
items.residualRisk: Remote-only and unreachable objects require separate hosted or forensic scope.

items.title: Complete current release assurance evidence
items.complexityRationale: Requires hosted CI, signing key custody, SBOM and provenance generation, independent review, and publication governance.
items.scope: release evidence, hosted CI, signing, SBOM, provenance, independent review, and release verification
implementationSteps: Finalize a clean revision and regenerate readiness.
Run Windows, Linux, and macOS on supported Node versions.
Generate SBOM and provenance, then sign and verify the candidate.
Obtain independent review bound to the exact revision.
Clear blockers only after all evidence validates.
acceptanceCriteria: Production release verification has no blockers.
items.rollout: Clear evidence blockers independently; publish only after all are complete.
items.rollback: Reinstate blockers and revoke affected artifacts if evidence becomes invalid.
items.approvalReason: Requires external CI, signing key custody, independent review, and possible publication.
items.residualRisk: Release assurance expires as code, dependencies, platforms, and keys change.

limitations: AUD-0201, AUD-0202, AUD-0203, AUD-0206, and AUD-0207 were closed by re-audit and are not scheduled again.
This plan does not execute remediation.
External and destructive actions remain separately approval-gated.
P3 must complete before P4 can establish release-grade secret-history assurance.
P1 and P2-execution-safety records predate immutable snapshots and remain historical evidence; new executions use schema 3.0 snapshots.
